bottom_line: Every future breaks this line somewhere before 2031, and in every one the break lands on a node already on the risk list. Three actions pay whichever way the world goes: confirm the internal numbers the pages rest on, test a 30-day manual fallback at both plants and both sole suppliers, and start qualifying a second cold-head maker by the second quarter of 2027.
where_we_are_heading: The read date leans toward trade staying a cost and helium still deciding whether a magnet ships. The Gulf strait saw four transits against a normal 85 on 11 October 2026, helium is bought on allocation letters, no listing names wire or cold heads, and no 3 tesla sealed magnet is cleared. Ten of twelve indicators lean that way; two lean neither. Nothing has settled.
what_fails_first: On the lean, helium cover at the United States magnet plant, in the winter of 2028 to 2029, when a grid curtailment or a flood takes the liquefier's power and the trailer road while the next container is still in its hold. Any hurricane season from 2027 can bring it forward. The China plant's helium queue breaches second, in the first half of 2028. If a listing lands first, the China plant stops in the second half of 2027 through its logic supply. If helium leaves the story, one Japanese cold head stops both plants.
what_it_costs: On the lean, one 30 to 45 day stop at the United States plant and a quarter of Western installs more than 30 days late, with share unmoved because every supplier is short of helium together. The costliest futures are the two where a part stops: the China plant off for a licence queue plus rehiring time with Asian share moving within one tender cycle, or both plants off for most of 18 months with the installed base warming and Europe's replacement peak going elsewhere.
right_in_every_future: Confirm the Placeholders now: the cover days, the backup power, the sealed test draw in litres, the China plant's logic stock in weeks, the cold-head maker's address and its parent's MR share. Test a 30-day manual fallback with the wire mill and the cold-head maker in the room, because a 35-day encryption event breaches the line in all four futures and lands wherever each future's first break already sits. Keep an offline, restore-tested copy of the design record. Start a second cold-head maker by the second quarter of 2027, once Sourcing names one with a letter of intent.
right_only_if_the_lean_holds: Helium cover at the United States plant above the container hold plus the ten-day grid rebuild, and the liquefier on backup power, both before the winter of 2028. They pay only where helium still decides, which is where the read date leans, and they are carrying cost if sealed magnets take most new builds. Stock at the China plant is a bet on a listing and has to be bought before the truce notice, first read as 10 November 2026. A multi-year agreement with the cold-head parent is a bet on an owner exit and does not survive a licence refusal.
one_action_waiting: Confirm the Placeholders. It costs phone calls, it has named owners in Logistics, Site operations, Engineering and Sourcing, and until it is done every other action on this page is sized to a synthetic number.
